items.text:
Data migration — phase 2 report

We moved the customer preferences table from the legacy MySQL cluster to Postgres on Tuesday night. The copy job ran for 3 h 20 min and matched checksums on 99.8% of rows; the remainder are soft-deleted records we chose to skip. The migration bot produced a per-table report in ops/reports/phase2.csv and the team reviewed it on Wednesday.

Remaining work: backfill the preferences JSON for accounts created before 2019, then switch the read path. The cutover is scheduled for the 18th, with a rollback window of 48 hours. No action is needed from other teams until the read path changes.
